mapper.select: select id, tenant_id, equipment_code, equipment_name, area_id, unit_id, equipment_type, running_status, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted from base_equipment where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted = 0

select id, tenant_id, equipment_code, equipment_name, area_id, unit_id, equipment_type, running_status, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted from base_equipment where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = 'ENABLED' and deleted = 0

select id, tenant_id, equipment_code, equipment_name, area_id, unit_id, equipment_type, running_status, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted from base_equipment where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and equipment_code = #{code} and deleted = 0
mapper.update: update base_equipment set equipment_name = #{equipmentName}, area_id = #{areaId}, unit_id = #{unitId}, equipment_type = #{equipmentType}, running_status = #{runningStatus}, status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted = 0
update base_equipment set status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted = 0
update base_equipment set deleted = 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and deleted = 0
